attchmntText: NACL Industries Limited has informed to the Stock Exchanges about Monitoring Agency Report for the period ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: NACL Industries Limited filed a monitoring agency report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue. The company raised Rs 24,928.91 lakh, with Crisil Ratings Limited acting as the monitoring agency. The report details that funds were utilized for repayment of borrowings, investment in wholly owned subsidiary NACL Spec-chem Limited, general corporate purposes, and issue expenses. No material deviations were observed. The statement of deviation and the monitoring agency report were submitted to the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: NACL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper publication
voiceSummary: NACL Industries Limited published its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 6, 2026. Standalone total income from operations was 35,926 lakhs, with a net profit after tax of 642 lakhs. Consolidated total income from operations was 31,712 lakhs, with a net loss after tax of 42 lakhs. Magadh Sugar and Energy Limited also filed results for the same period. Foseco India Limited reported consolidated net profit after tax of 4,018.81 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 6, 2026. B.A.G. Films and Media Limited filed its unaudited results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 5, 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 76.940 lakhs.
